meta.name: Score and triage job applicants with Airtable, Google Drive and OpenAI

name: HR Job Posting and Evaluation with AI

parameters.content:
## HR Job Posting and Evaluation with AI

### How it works

This workflow automates an HR candidate intake and evaluation process from form submission through interview preparation. It uploads and records applicant details, extracts CV content, uses AI to assess fit, then routes candidates into rejected or potential hire records. For shortlisted candidates, it generates questionnaires, sends a personalized email, books a phone meeting, and stores tailored screening questions.

### Setup steps

- Configure the form trigger fields for applicant name, phone, email, experience, and CV upload.
- Connect Google Drive credentials and set the target folder for CV upload/download.
- Configure Airtable credentials, bases, and tables for applicant records, job postings, candidate insights, questionnaire updates, meeting times, rejection records, and screening questions.
- Connect OpenAI credentials for the AI Agent and OpenAI nodes, and review prompts/output schemas for candidate scoring, questionnaire generation, email personalization, booking, and screening questions.
- Set up email sending credentials and verify the sender, subject, and recipient field mappings.
- Connect Google Calendar credentials for the meeting-booking tool and choose the calendar/availability rules to use.

### Customization

Adjust the AI evaluation criteria, shortlist threshold, Airtable field mappings, generated questionnaire format, email tone, meeting duration, and screening-question templates to match the hiring process.

## Collect applicant intake

Starts when an applicant submits the form, uploads the CV to Google Drive, formats key applicant fields, and creates or updates the initial Airtable record.

## Extract CV content

Downloads the stored CV from Google Drive and extracts readable text so it can be analyzed by AI.

## Evaluate candidate fit

Uses the AI Agent with OpenAI, Airtable lookup access, and a structured output parser to evaluate the CV and decide whether the applicant should be shortlisted.

## Record hiring decision

Writes the branch outcome to Airtable, saving rejected candidates separately from potential hires who continue through the process.

## Generate candidate questionnaire

For potential hires, generates tailored questionnaire content with AI using Airtable context, presents it in a form, and updates Airtable with the completed questionnaire data.

## Prepare and send email

Creates a personalized candidate email using job posting and candidate insight data, maps the generated content into email fields, and sends the message.

## Schedule phone meeting

Uses AI with Google Calendar access to book a phone screening meeting, then saves the scheduled meeting time back to Airtable.

## Create screening questions

Generates tailored phone-screening questions from job posting and candidate insight data, formats the output field, and stores the questions in Airtable.

=Fill this for to apply for the role Automation Specialist:

Location: Remote
Experience: Minimum 3 years
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Automation Specialist with at least 3 years of experience in designing and implementing workflow automation solutions. The ideal candidate will have expertise in tools such as n8n, Zapier, Make.com, or similar platforms, and a strong background in integrating APIs, streamlining processes, and enhancing operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

 Develop and implement automated workflows to optimize business processes.
 Integrate third-party APIs and systems to create seamless data flow.
 Analyze, debug, and improve existing automation setups.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify automation opportunities.
 Monitor and maintain automation systems to ensure reliability.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

 Proven 3+ years of experience in workflow automation and integration.
 Proficiency with tools like n8n, Zapier, or Make.com.
 Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, and data transformation.
 Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript or Python).
 Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

 Experience with database management and cloud services.
 Background in business process analysis or RPA tools.

Why Join Us?

 Opportunity to work on cutting-edge automation projects.
 Supportive and collaborative team environment.
 Competitive salary and benefits package.
